name: run_on_cloud
description: Submit a Maestro flow (or folder of flows) to Maestro Cloud for execution on cloud devices. Returns immediately with an upload_id and dashboard URL. Use get_cloud_run_status to poll for results. Requires Maestro Cloud authentication: run `maestro login` (recommended), or set MAESTRO_CLOUD_API_KEY for non-interactive use.

app_file.description: Path to the app binary (.apk, .ipa, or .zip). Absolute or relative to the current working directory.

device_model.description: Cloud device model (e.g. `iPhone-17-Pro`, `pixel_6`). Call `list_cloud_devices` for valid values.

device_os.description: Cloud device OS version, case-sensitive (e.g. `iOS-17-5`, `android-34`). Call `list_cloud_devices` for valid values.

env.description: Optional map of environment variables to inject into the flows (e.g. {"APP_ID": "com.example.app"}).

exclude_tags.description: Skip flows that have any of these tags.

flows.description: Path to a single flow file or a folder containing flows. Absolute or relative to the current working directory.

include_tags.description: Only run flows that have any of these tags.

name.description: Optional human-readable name for this upload.

project_id.description: Optional Maestro Cloud project ID. If omitted and the account has exactly one project, it is auto-selected; if the account has multiple projects, this parameter is required.
